title: How Much Does a Kitchen Remodel Cost in Massachusetts? (2026 Breakdown)
metaTitle: Kitchen Remodel Cost in Massachusetts (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Massachusetts in 2026? Real North Shore price ranges, where the money goes, and the line items that blow budgets.
secondaryKeywords: how much does a kitchen remodel cost in massachusetts

faq.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Massachusetts in 2026?
faq.a: Most kitchen remodels in Essex and Middlesex County fall between $35,000 and $65,000 for a full mid-range remodel. Cosmetic refreshes start around $18,000, and full gut renovations with layout changes can reach $120,000 or more. Local labor and permitting run above the national average, so estimates should always be priced for the North Shore, not from a national calculator.

faq.q: What is the most expensive part of a kitchen remodel?
faq.a: Cabinetry, which typically accounts for 30% to 40% of the total budget. The choice between stock, semi-custom and custom cabinets moves your final number more than any other single decision.

faq.q: Do I need a permit to remodel my kitchen in Massachusetts?
faq.a: In almost all cases, yes. Massachusetts requires a building permit for most kitchen remodels, and separate electrical and plumbing permits when those systems are altered. A licensed contractor pulls these for you, and unpermitted work can create problems when you sell the home.

faq.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
faq.a: A typical full kitchen remodel runs six to ten weeks once work begins, depending on scope, material lead times and whether structural or plumbing changes are involved. A clear schedule should be part of your estimate from the start.

faq.q: How can I keep my kitchen remodel on budget?
faq.a: Keep the existing layout when possible, choose semi-custom cabinets, invest in the surfaces you use daily, and insist on a detailed line-item estimate instead of a vague range. The clearer the estimate, the fewer surprises during the build.
